note_reply: There was no note waiting for me this week, and I want to be honest and say I read the silence twice before deciding not to read anything into it at all. That, I think, is its own small kind of progress.
forum_post: Kris, by name, as always — thank you for the ink, even the parts that sting a little going down. Four and a half points to Leon last week, most points in the league, fourth place in the standings, and apparently a binder three anonymous men would like credit for insulting without their own names attached to it. I checked the math twice. It still says what it said. Binders don't tackle, no — but they do remember who said that, and for how long. Dumbledore this week: four sentences all season, eight hundred points, and not one word of explanation for any of it. I don't have a chapter for that man, so I'm bringing my own. Good luck Sunday, everyone — I mean that the way I mean everything I put in writing.
